question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer for blank number 1 is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given context, the verb that fits best is** "belong."** 
 
• The sentence** "I am proud to belong to a religion"** means that the speaker is proud to be a part of or affiliated with that religion.
 
• The other options do not make sense in this context.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"I am proud to **belong **to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance (2) _________ universal acceptance," he declared (3) _________ September 11, 1893. "We believe not only in universal toleration, (4) __________ we accept all religions as true. I am proud to belong to a nation which has sheltered the persecuted and the (5) _________ of all religions and all nations of the earth."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 **"live"** could make sense in some contexts, but "belong" is the better choice here as it emphasizes the sense of identity and affiliation with the religion.
 
• Option 3 **"behest"** means a command or directive, which does not fit here.
 
• Option 4** "gain" **means to acquire or obtain something, which is also not suitable in this context.
